text_block_list.text: Bravo. That was quite the rescue, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems my supreme beauty, unclouded even 
through glass, has bestowed power upon 
you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! No need for thanks! After all, my 
beauty exists to save the world!
